description: p8's input with `x_undefined: 1` added to the attestation by the attestor outside the parties. Each object in `attestations` is closed in independence_claim, defining `by` and `role`, so the record rejects with unknown_member_reject. p8 is the accepting twin. An engine that ignores members it does not read inside an attestation accepts a claim without evaluating what such a member states. Rests on `defined_members` in MANIFEST.json.
